key_insight: Open-source LLMs can convert messy longitudinal liver-disease clinical notes into structured patient timelines at scale.
clinical_relevance: This could help researchers study chronic liver disease progression and liver cancer risk factors more efficiently using routine care data.
method: Manually annotated 507 reports from 30 patients across radiology, pathology, and transplant assessments.
Benchmarked four open-source LLMs against a regex baseline across 73 extraction tasks.
Compared constrained decoding vs unconstrained prompting, then applied the best pipeline to 835 transplant patients.
evidence_signal: Llama 3.3 70B exceeded 90% accuracy on 59 of 73 tasks, and constrained decoding achieved >99.9% format adherence while the final pipeline extracted 37,125 datapoints from 22,493 reports.
watch_item: Performance was tested in a single-centre transplant cohort, so broader generalization and deployment quality should be validated before routine use.
paper_title: LLM-based reconstruction of longitudinal clinical trajectories in chronic liver disease.
